The line representing 'Д Банк' is light blue in the chart, not purple ('лилава').

errors.text_span: Синята линия, представляваща ЦКБ, започва от 11% през 2008 година
errors.evidence: The blue line (ЦКБ) starts at approximately 14% in 2008, not 11%.
Referring to the blue line (ЦКБ), its value in 2010 is approximately 12%, not 9%.

errors.text_span: След това се покачва до 13% през 2012 година
errors.evidence: Referring to the blue line (ЦКБ), its value in 2012 is approximately 10%, not 13%. The trend is also described incorrectly as an increase from the previous point.
Referring to the orange line (Инвест банк), its value increases from ~8% in 2008 to ~10% in 2010. The description incorrectly states it decreases to 7%.

errors.text_span: остава сравнително стабилна около 10% до 2016 година

Referring to the yellow line (Интернешънъл Асет Банк), it ends at approximately 9% in 2027, not 8%.
Referring to the line for 'Д Банк' (which is light blue), it starts at approximately 15.5% in 2008, not 11%.

errors.evidence: Referring to the light blue line ('Д Банк'), in 2012 there is a trough at approximately 8.5%, not a peak at 12%.
The green line (Тексим банк) decreases to a value of approximately 16.5% in 2011, not 22%.
